def load():

from collections import Counter,deque
def f(I, par='manhattan'):
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for row in I for x in row); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    seeds=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if I[r][c]!=bg]

    others={k for k,v in cnt.items() if k!=bg}; oth=list(others-{sv})[0]
    O=[row[:] for row in I]
    seen={(seed[0],seed[1])}; q=deque([seed])
    while q:
        r,c=q.popleft()
        for dr,dc in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
            nr,nc=r+dr,c+dc
            if 0<=nr<H and 0<=nc<W and I[nr][nc]==bg and (nr,nc) not in seen:
